race.comment: SET ME LOOSE (3) will be deservedly short in betting here. She's a lightly raced filly who has shown ability far beyond this grade, a dominant winner in this sort of company fresh at Seymour which saw her jump $3.40 against much better opposition at Caulfield. Anything like that should see her too good for these. SURPRISATIC (1) hit the frame two starts ago at Bendigo before an even effort at Mildura last time. He should take some holding out. CODENAME (5) proved too slick to break his maiden at Mildura in a small field last start. Harder now but could place. MONIX (2) is a handy sort around this level and enjoys racing here at home. He should be thereabouts.
